changes: Added a cohort-only Goals workspace with canonical focus controls and task follow-through
Added a cohort-gated Chat-first desktop shell with direct navigation to conversations, tasks, goals, and memories
Added a focused task checklist with inline planning controls for the chat-first experience
Made Chat-first responses reliably show interactive tasks, goals, memories, conversations, and screen evidence
Agent cloud VMs now require auth on health checks so database status is not publicly readable
Improved desktop chat performance with a recent-message window and subtle hover timestamps
Improved chat answers that depend on the current local time
Fixed onboarding shortcut choices and improved desktop app bundle reliability
Fixed reliability of macOS update builds
Improved reliability for microphone monitoring and device names when using Oakley Meta glasses
Added a Floating Bar setting to mute in-app notification previews while keeping macOS notifications
Stopped reporting an ordinary idle voice-socket disconnect as a realtime session error
Fixed the Conversations sidebar item opening the Conversations hub
Fixed task drag-and-drop placement and protected existing task lists from being cleared during migration recovery
Omi Beta now uses the development Python and desktop backend endpoints while preserving the production Firebase account and Firestore data plane
Reduced task reorder sync cost by assigning sparse sort-order ranks and sending only moved tasks, with bounded rebalance batches for legacy or exhausted ranks
Fixed large task reorder syncs by sending sort-order updates in bounded batches instead of surfacing a cloud sync error
Fixed deleted-account Rewind data carrying into a later sign-in
Improved Brain Map loading to securely include the complete server graph across bounded pages while remaining compatible with older backends
Fixed chat opening scrolled to the top of your history after you clicked anywhere in the transcript while it was still loading
Fixed chat transcripts pulling readers back to the bottom after they explicitly scroll into history
Fixed chat scrolling so returning to the newest message resumes following again, and a message sent elsewhere no longer yanks you to the bottom while you are scrolling

Fixed chat startup to always land at the bottom, preserved explicit reader scroll position, kept the transcript and prompt rail responsive through repeated fast scrolling and scroll-view replacement, and prevented duplicate scrollbars, bottom snapping, and beachballs

Restored full Tasks and Conversations functionality in the modern desktop shell, fixed full-row conversation selection, kept Memory menus above the page, and made Brain Map open the correct cohort-specific experience
Bounded stalled desktop Gemini requests and prevented automatic replay of timeout outcomes
Avoid duplicate local transcripts when the same system-audio playback is also heard by the microphone
Routed managed chat through Luna and stopped passive account permission prompts during onboarding and startup
Prevented live microphone changes from racing the previous capture while it shuts down
Fixed naming transcript speakers so assignments persist for legacy conversations and failed saves can be retried
Made Today, Tomorrow, and Later complete while No Deadline tasks load automatically in bounded pages at the bottom of the Tasks view
Improved chat reply timestamps and inline expansion controls
Fixed Escape navigation from Chat-first pages
Improved chat navigation responsiveness, scroll positioning, markdown tables and code copying, and restored Omi branding across desktop surfaces
Improved chat transcript responsiveness during long streaming conversations and added safeguards that catch slow navigation and Ask Omi feedback
Hardened Tasks pagination, Memories archive loading, chat admission, and capture detail refresh so stale data and interrupted loads are less likely to appear in the desktop app
Fixed desktop web-search routing so public lookups work while private and explicitly no-web requests stay local
Omi Chat can now save an explicitly requested memory with safer confirmation and retry handling
Restored the Omi logo in named desktop bundles and placed Listening directly before Capture in the chat header.

Added a SwiftUI and AppKit runtime-debugging playbook covering authority and identity mapping, first-impossible-transition tracing, native-boundary reproduction, mounted regression tests, and named-bundle verification
Fixed the Memory atlas so unlinked canonical memories are kept out of the relationship map instead of appearing as disconnected dots
Redesigned the app around a translucent glass interface, with a new animated intro and ambient sound during setup
Fixed setup getting stuck when a permission was granted after a delay, and Omi now offers to reopen itself when screen access needs a restart to take effect
Finishing setup now shows you how to reach Omi and what to ask first, using your own shortcuts and the connectors you actually set up
Added a microphone button to the chat and ask bars so you can start a voice turn with a click instead of holding a key
Improved recovery when your desktop agent VM is being updated or restarted
Made Memory Atlas keep relationship clusters prominent while unlinked memories stay in a quiet, circular background cloud.
Improved Memory Atlas so your identity stays at the center and unconnected memories form a readable circular cloud
Memory Atlas now shows every canonical memory while keeping verified relationship clusters distinct.
Pasting a conversation ID or share link into search now opens the exact conversation.
Fixed deleting default memories from the desktop Memories menu
Switching accounts while a chat tool is writing to your local data no longer reports that write's result into the new account's chat.
Restored the Conversations tab in the old Home design
Fixed chat silently accepting every message on an install whose local AI runtime was incomplete — it now says so up front and points at the repair instead of failing each turn

Fixed assistant interval sliders showing the wrong handle position for a value synced from your account, and added 1-minute, 5-minute and 30-minute steps between the old 10-second and 10-minute extremes

Settings ▸ Advanced now shows the Task, Insight and Memory assistant controls again — switches, intervals, confidence, app rules and prompts — so you can turn each assistant off, and the gear on the Tasks page lands on the Task Assistant card instead of nothing

Tightened the chat transcript so short messages read as a conversation: replies sit close to the question that caused them, message actions and timestamps no longer reserve empty space, and proactive notifications are shown as pushes rather than as stray lines

Replaced the top bar's Library hover menu with a flat row of destinations — Home, Library, Tasks, Rewind, Insights and Apps are one click each, the Memory hub now carries its own Conversations / Memories / Brain Map switcher on its page, and the Omi mark is no longer duplicated in the bar
Added a Brain Map button to Home's filter row so the map is one click from the search surface
Home's chat can be copied, cleared and reopened again — the conversation menu and a 'Chat' chip that takes you back to your transcript after you navigate away
Added file attachments and a Stop button to Home's query bar, so you can send files with a question and end a response that is taking too long
Home now shows your whole history — every conversation, memory and screen moment loads in the background instead of stopping after the newest few days

Onboarding now says what turning on screen access actually starts — an ongoing Rewind timeline you can scrub back through and switch off — offers a summon shortcut that doesn't take ⌘O away from your other apps, and tells you the window steps aside when you click elsewhere
Added Permissions and Help to the Settings list, and tapping a "Help from Founder" notification now opens the support thread instead of doing nothing
Reapplied the preferred microphone when it reconnects during Listening
Fixed the post-setup "try asking" suggestions never appearing on Home, and made the Conversations menu item (⌘2) open Conversations instead of whichever Library view you looked at last
Removed the Focus assistant and its page — Omi no longer watches for distractions or scores your focus, and its settings are gone from Advanced and Notifications
Removed the Insights page — the insight assistant still runs and its findings still arrive as memories and notifications
Rewind's timeline now floats on glass instead of rendering onto your wallpaper, and dragging the timeline scrubs through the day again rather than moving the window

Fixed Settings: custom API keys are now checked once after you finish typing instead of on every keystroke and show a per-provider Valid/Invalid badge, Rewind storage reports an unreadable store instead of a permanent "Loading..." or a false "Zero KB", searching for Sign Out or Plan and Usage now jumps to the right card, and editing your AI profile no longer discards the edit when saving fails
Settings ▸ Transcription now says when Auto-Detect is not available for your language instead of ticking an option the transcriber ignores
Settings ▸ Transcription now tells you when the microphone you picked is not connected, and lets you switch back to the Mac's input device
Task, Insight and Memory notification switches in Settings now follow assistant settings synced from your account instead of showing pre-sync values
Settings ▸ Advanced now remembers whether you revealed Profile and Stats instead of re-hiding it every launch

Rescan Files now shows progress and how many files are indexed instead of doing nothing visible, and the AI Chat pane's Skills refresh and workspace picker re-scan from disk so newly added skills and a changed project folder show up
Fixed Settings search results for Screen Capture, Audio Recording, Reset Window Size, Transcription and Private Cloud Sync landing on the wrong pane or scrolling to nothing
Fixed Settings ▸ Transcription silently reverting Single Language back to Auto-Detect — picking a language now survives reopening Settings
The top navigation now sits on its own panel of glass, lined up with the search bar beneath it, and the main window drops its title-bar buttons so it reads as one floating surface over your desktop
Omi's main window is now a panel you summon with ⌃⌘O — it floats over your work, dismisses with Escape or a click away, and remembers where you put it on each display
Added a chevron to each day on Home's timeline that folds that day away, with the day's counts still on the header so you can see what is behind it
Home's timeline now sets each moment apart, keeps a memory's sentence to a readable line length, and states a memory's category once instead of repeating it at the front of every line
Chat now explains a billing rejection in plain language instead of showing a raw "HTTP 402" status and inviting you to retry a message that can never go through
Cleaned up the chat composer on Home — a fully rounded field with room around what you type, and one quiet send button instead of three controls competing for your eye
Opening chat on Home now reads like an ordinary chat window — the composer sits inside the panel under the transcript and the search bar goes away until you go back to your results

A chat message that fails now says so right under the question that failed, and stays there — instead of leaving your question with no reply and a dismissible card that disappears; your typed text also comes back to the composer so you can send it again
Fixed chat scrolling stalling for the whole of a streamed answer and then jumping, the ask bar keeping the question you just sent, and the caret going missing after Escape or coming back to Omi
Fixed chat messages shifting down while you scroll — hovering a reply no longer makes the transcript grow under the pointer
Stopped chat showing two spinners at once — while a tool is running, only the card naming it moves
Fixed chat getting stuck on "sending" — with no way back except relaunching — when your session was refreshed or chat settings changed while a reply was still coming in

Fixed chat and other panels being hard to read when the window floats over a browser or document — text and pages behind the window no longer show through strongly enough to interleave with what Omi is showing you, while the panels stay translucent
Home's capture count now says what it counted, so it no longer reads as a contradiction next to the day's screen-moment rail
Home's hour rail now names the day it counts, so its screen-moment total no longer reads as a contradiction of the account-wide count in the panel corner
Fixed the Omi mark spinning forever when nothing was loading, prices written with a tilde being struck through in answers, and the two capture counts on Home disagreeing about what they counted
Fixed modals darkening a rectangle of your desktop instead of the app — the dim now stops at the app's own panels
Fixed the first-run screens rendering their copy straight onto your wallpaper, and removed the empty sheet of glass that was drawn around the window
Fixed the onboarding intro playing on a second display instead of the one you are working on
Typing on Home searches as you type and Return sends to chat — the separate Search and Ask buttons are gone
The Home search bar is a real composer now — it grows as you write, keeps every line of what you paste, and takes Shift-Return for a new line
Restart and Reset Onboarding now replays the cinematic intro, the way a real first run does

Rewind now reaches your whole capture history — search spans all time, the day picker jumps to the oldest capture and states the real span, and a new "Keep everything" retention option stops older screen recordings being deleted
Fixed screen-history semantic search missing everything captured after the initial backfill — newly captured frames were never queued for embedding
Fixed Rewind drawing a blue rectangle on the desktop when you opened the search filters
Fixed Rewind's date pill, zoom buttons and segment arrows floating away from the screenshot instead of sitting on it
Made Rewind's capture-span line legible in the day picker
Fixed Rewind's meaning-based search silently skipping everything captured recently, because newly recorded screens were never indexed for it
Removed Rewind's ↵ Search hint — results already narrow as you type
Conversation share links now honor the configured share host
Fixed the Reset Onboarding confirmation dimming the desktop behind the window instead of the app

Made the top bar's listening and screen-capture controls readable at a glance: the state dot now shows on, off and blocked as three clearly different marks instead of three near-identical badges, and the screen control uses a plain display icon
Fixed the main window vanishing whenever another app took focus — it now floats in front of your work and stays where you put it until you dismiss it with Escape or ⌘W
The top bar's microphone and screen icons now draw a line through themselves when they are off, and hovering one says which capability it is — audio or screen — and what state it is in
Fixed Settings → Advanced → AI User Profile: Save and Delete silently did nothing right after Regenerate
